[ce] CalcExpress - Not a CE InstanceRef.vi

Owning Palette: CalcExpress

The VI validates a reference to a CalcExpress instance context.

Click the parameters for more information

 

CE InstanceRef is a reference number for a CalcExpress instance that contains a parsed CalcExpress expression/script. CalcExpress - Parse Script.vi returns a value that can be wired directly to this terminal.
dynamically opened returns TRUE if CE InstanceRef refers to dynamically created CalcExpress instance context; otherwise, it returrns FALSE.
not a CE Instance returns TRUE if CE InstanceRef is an invalid reference; otherwise, it returns FALSE.
